name: Neural Surface Rendering Training (Eikonal & Boundary Regularization)
aliases: Eikonal and Boundary Regularization for Neural Surfaces
Neural SDF Training with Image Reconstruction and Eikonal Regularization
definition: Trains a neural surface rendering model by combining image reconstruction loss with Eikonal and boundary regularization losses to enforce SDF properties.
summary: Neural Surface Rendering Training optimizes a neural Signed Distance Function using Eikonal and boundary regularization to render images, differing from standard volume rendering by optimizing an explicit surface representation.
